summary: Kept the cleanup focused on the receiver, which was the largest mixed-responsibility file, and removed its unused `FileRequests.dirs` field. The first attempt split the sender too and measured 5,147 changed lines, so I reverted those extra splits; the final patch is 2,437 changed lines outside tests. All four gate commands pass.
diagnosis: The first gate measured 5,147 changed lines because splitting both `transfer.rs` and `transfer/receiver.rs` moved roughly 2,500 lines in each direction. I kept the receiver split only: `transfer/receiver.rs` went from 1,710 to 546 lines, with `receiver/dir.rs` (632) and `receiver/data.rs` (593). Final diff is 1,255 insertions and 1,182 deletions, total 2,437, under the 3,000-line ceiling.
change: Moved directory decoding/comparison/generation into `transfer/receiver/dir.rs` and DATA decoding/assembly/publication into `transfer/receiver/data.rs`, leaving `receiver.rs` as coordination and worker scheduling. Removed the unused `FileRequests.dirs` field and its dead-code suppression. README gained only the dated changelog section.
expected_effect: No behavior or wire-byte changes; the receiver is now divided into coordination, directory work, and data work that can be read and tested separately.
risks: The change is a mechanical code move plus removal of an unused field. The main risk is a missed import or visibility adjustment, which the full test suite, clippy, formatting, and aarch64 checks cover.
tests: Ran all four required commands successfully: `XS_BIN=... cargo test --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml` (all unit and integration suites passed, including workers, resume, delta, filters, xattrs, acls, interop, output, ownership, hardlink, and io_control), `cargo clippy --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --check`, and `cargo check --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`.
commit_title: Split the xs-rs receiver and log merged steps
commit_body: Move directory comparison and DATA handling out of transfer/receiver.rs into transfer/receiver/dir.rs and transfer/receiver/data.rs, leaving receiver.rs to coordinate readers and workers. Remove the unused FileRequests.dirs field. Add the 2026-10-21 changelog entry for the merged steps and these cleanups. No behavior or wire-format changes.
